name: io.github.sra1phani/domain-finder
title: Domain Finder
description: Check if a brand name is free across domains, GitHub, npm and PyPI, and suggest available names.

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Check whether one or more candidate names are free across domains and the GitHub / npm / PyPI namespaces, in a single call.

tools.name: generate_names
tools.description: Generate candidate names from a description, each pre-checked for domain availability; feed the favorites into check_name.
